input.prompt:
FORMAT: One continuous 23-second take containing exactly 0 cuts, one unbroken handheld shot from the first frame to the last. Real-time pacing throughout at a brisk walking speed.

CAST: SUBJECT A is the woman in @Image1. Do not restyle her or change her age or face shape. She reads early forties, roughly 5'6", so the tote hangs at hip height in the crook of her elbow. SUBJECT B is a friend who holds the camera, stays behind it the whole take and is never visible.

WARDROBE (identical for the whole take): rust brown suede jacket over a cream turtleneck, dark straight jeans, small gold huggie hoop earrings, bare hands.

SET: A quiet sunlit lane on a clear autumn afternoon. Whitewashed stucco garden walls both sides, a pale sandy gravel road underfoot running bright, dark green cypress along the top of the walls, dry leaves at the edge. The lane is open, empty and uncluttered.

PRODUCT: The bag in @Image2 and @Image3, exactly as shown, never changing. Oatmeal brushed wool felt body, trapezoid tote wider at the top, flat base, structured enough to stand upright unaided. Exactly 2 handles, caramel leather along the upper arc and oatmeal wool down the legs, and those legs continue down the FRONT face as exactly 2 vertical wool straps. Exactly 1 caramel leather belt crosses the FRONT face behind both straps, its 2 ends curving down and outward into exactly 1 round gold disc cap each, 2 caps total and the only hardware outside. The mouth is a plain open rim of wool edge to edge. Every outer surface is blank wool and plain caramel leather. Inside it are a matte charcoal laptop held edge on, a folded cream knit and a metal water bottle, and those contents fill the inside completely, packed up against the walls and level with the rim.

LOOK: Shot on an iPhone rear camera, handheld by the friend walking backward at pace, slightly imperfect framing, real hand shake, mild sensor noise. Hard high sun sits above and behind her from camera right, throwing short sharp shadows forward and to camera left and putting a bright rim along her shoulder. Her face is keyed from below by light bouncing up off the pale gravel road, so the shadows under her nose and chin stay soft. The whitewashed wall at camera left fills the rest. High contrast, high saturation, deep blue sky, highlights clipping on the white wall. Straight out of a phone. Photographic, not rendered.

VOICE: SUBJECT A is an early forties American woman, warm, high energy, slightly breathless from the pace, talking to a close friend, expressive natural intonation, energy holding through the final word. SUBJECT B is a similar age American woman heard from behind the camera, quieter and off-mic. Close phone-mic outdoors, no studio polish. There is no narrator and no voiceover. Exactly two people speak, SUBJECT A on camera and SUBJECT B holding the camera, and nobody else says anything.

SOUND: Ambient outdoor tone only. No music, no BGM. <two sets of footsteps on pavement> <light breeze>.

BEATS

[00:00-00:05] SHOT 1. OPEN.
  FRAME: medium, waist up, camera walking backward in front of her at a brisk pace, eye level
  ACTION: SUBJECT A walks straight at the lens, tote in the crook of her right elbow, looking at the camera
  DIALOGUE: "Okay, I'm freaking obsessed with this bag. I've had it on me all week."

[00:05-00:09] SHOT 2. CONTINUOUS.
  FRAME: same setup, drifting down toward the bag
  ACTION: still walking, SUBJECT A swings the open top toward the lens so the packed contents show
  DIALOGUE: "Look how much is in here, and it isn't even full."

[00:09-00:14] SHOT 3. CONTINUOUS.
  FRAME: same setup, holding on the open bag
  ACTION: still walking, SUBJECT A points into the bag with her free index finger, touching each item in turn
  DIALOGUE: "That's my laptop, a sweater, a water bottle, and basically my whole day."

[00:14-00:18] SHOT 4. CONTINUOUS.
  FRAME: same setup, rising back to waist up
  ACTION: SUBJECT A settles the tote back into the crook of her elbow and keeps walking
  DIALOGUE: "And it still looks like the nice bag. Nothing sags."

[00:18-00:20] SHOT 5. CONTINUOUS.
  FRAME: same setup, still tracking backward
  ACTION: SUBJECT A glances just past the lens and grins, eyebrows up, while SUBJECT B speaks the line from behind the camera
  DIALOGUE: "Okay, that is really cute."

[00:20-00:23] SHOT 6. CONTINUOUS.
  FRAME: camera slows and stops, she walks away from it and the framing widens
  ACTION: SUBJECT A turns her head back over her shoulder toward the lens, then keeps walking away
  DIALOGUE: "Right? Come on, I'm freezing."

CONTINUITY: SUBJECT A is the same person throughout, identical face, hair and skin tone. Same jacket, turtleneck, jeans and earrings every second. Same hard sun from above and behind camera right, same bright road bounce on her face, for the whole take. SUBJECT B stays behind the camera and is never seen. Two voices only, each consistent in pitch and accent. The bag is identical throughout, same oatmeal body, caramel belt, 2 gold disc caps and proportions.

TEXT: No on-screen text, subtitles, watermarks or rendered logos.

NEGATIVES: no music, no slow motion, no cinematic color grading, no 3D render or CGI look, no plastic skin, no other people, no onlookers, no cuts.
